headword: {駆|か}け{込|こ}み{乗車|じょうしゃ}

definitions.gloss: rushing onto a departing train; last-second boarding
definitions.explanation: running to catch a train just as the doors are about to close, considered dangerous and often discouraged

examples.japanese: {駆|か}け{込|こ}み{乗車|じょうしゃ}は{危険|きけん}です。
examples.english: Rushing onto a departing train is dangerous.

examples.japanese: {駆|か}け{込|こ}み{乗車|じょうしゃ}はおやめください。
examples.english: Please refrain from rushing onto departing trains.

examples.japanese: {遅刻|ちこく}しそうで、つい{駆|か}け{込|こ}み{乗車|じょうしゃ}してしまった。
examples.english: I was about to be late, so I ended up rushing onto the train at the last second.

notes:
COMPOUND:
{駆|か}け{込|こ}む (to rush in) + {乗車|じょうしゃ} (boarding a train)

SAFETY WARNING:
Frequently announced in stations:
- {危険|きけん}ですのでおやめください
- {次|つぎ}の{電車|でんしゃ}をお{待|ま}ちください

CONSEQUENCES:
- Getting caught in closing doors
- Missing belongings on platform
- Causing train delays

RELATED:
- {発車|はっしゃ}ベル - departure bell
- ホームドア - platform screen doors
- {乗|の}り{遅|おく}れる - to miss a train
- {次発|じはつ} - next train
